assumptions: SC01/GT04 casualty-work scheduling override (authored, uncalibrated; not catalog urgency): casualty_work_policy sets locally believed major/destroyed-building T014=82 above corroborated camera-candidate T027=81, T033=89 above T029=86, and T034=90 above new loading, below T035=91; T031=94 and all physical guards remain unchanged. A waiting proposed T014 is monotonically promoted once on delivered major/destroyed damage, clearing its old allocation retry delay without A050 or a new revision; later damage estimates remain unchanged and this promotion is not damage certainty. Other first-search priorities, uncertainty, observations and ordinary residents stay intact. At real action boundaries, queued substantive A053/A056/A057/A058 controls run before another old method/approach starts, and an in-flight commitment change holds that lane until its result; this neither instantly stops an active action nor releases occupancy. Assignments include the known person response/evidence for an exact belief.entity_ref alias, so existing stale-contact checks can cancel already resolved contacts through A054; no distance-only identity, mobile/uninjured-to-no-needs inference or truth role filter is introduced. A queued T014 is canceled as stale when a locally received belief.search_status=complete already resolves its building, including recheck before A008 after travel; this adds no search success and partial/inconclusive T015 remains eligible. Missing medical stock stays a real A019 failure: catalog A024 needs C24 and A028 needs C27; neither is granted to the specialist. Existing carrier transport and receiver-side T031 remain available. No payload, pickup range, receiver, road, hidden truth or capability is changed, and a rescue within 3600 s is not asserted without a run.
v0.5 scripted sensing/network/compute; no vision, ns-3 or calibrated rescue physics.

Access-route blockage is an initial-condition constraint: the source building, boundary road entry and matching blocked junction segment are sampled together so the blockage lies on the public-map shortest route to that building plot access. Authored collapse reach is 28 m measured from the actual initial building model footprint to actual debris; plot edges are approximately 14-16.5 m off the carriageway. Rubble has the asset footprint (its transverse width determines remaining road clearance), abstract 0.2 m step height and 120 work units. Clearance and rescue still require ordinary agent observations, tools, messages and actions.
Specialist team has installed catalog rescue/clearance tools but 20 kg carrying capacity in this configuration, so a person needs the ground vehicle; dog capabilities are unchanged.

A3 authored equipment assumption: the professional team carries range measurement (C09/scripted_range) and local route planning (C14) for Q022/Q023 access verification. Existing C16/C17 remain its clearance interfaces; no capability implies guaranteed work success.

A3 authored vehicle assumption: this transport vehicle (displayed as the produced RSC-008-C01 van ambulance, lane P5: closed, or the LOADED state while it truly carries a person) retains catalog C22 personnel loading/transport and the inherited 800 kg total payload rating, but has no C16 manipulation or C17 engineering tools. Q033/Q034 permit its own C22 loading; they do not require a second loading actor. The specialist's 20 kg capacity is not enlarged.

A3 mission scope: specialist autonomous proposals cover T022/T023/T033; extrication remains the existing received A059/A017 service. Vehicle blockage observations must reach the coordinator before coordinator clearance proposals can exist. Allowlists restrict proposals, while executor capability, embodiment and payload checks govern assignments and self-acceptance.

Task allowlists define this compact mission scope; all selected tasks still require local belief rules, messages, capability checks and allocation. Coordinator forwards measured route updates through the scripted network.
Search misses, action failures, unassigned tasks and unfinished objectives remain visible. A receiving point is an abstract staffed station with explicit confirmation and finite capacity.
Speeds, radio ranges, sensing probabilities, durations and work rates inherited from v0.5 are uncalibrated model assumptions. Models/glyphs are display assets only.

Produced asset NEW-ENG-001-C01 (compact wheel loader, lane P1, not yet in the formal Excel) is the display model of clearance_loader-1, a catalog ground_vehicle embodiment configured with heavy-clearance capability C17 (A013) plus sensing/route/comms capabilities; it parks off the carriageway near the deployment entry and is only one clearance candidate - allocation still chooses between it and the specialist team.

Opt-in scene-v0.6 @ 4a9dccb supplies the normal capacity layout, independent RNG stages, same-parent damage reservation and pre-bootstrap authored activation events. Density and search budgets come from the referenced route-a-3 rules; no density is hardcoded in this adapter.

Imported physical people retain their source truth fields and raw pose metadata; existing human_pose may select the already-produced P2 supine variant for immobile people, whose pose-specific collision remains unvalidated. Upstream population_truth_candidates stay in evaluator-only audit, except the one selected cohort member explicitly materialized as this configured incident; pinned_occupants=0 explicitly suppresses a second G02 population, and does not assert that normal D0 buildings are unoccupied. Indoor support/entrances remain source gaps.

RouteATerrain supplies exact nonuniform T0/T1 support and physical road tops. Static upstream GLBs retain full matrices through display-frame wrappers, with original bytes/hashes referenced. Existing vehicle/loader/ambulance display models and capabilities are retained.

Existing core runtime remains planar; upstream layered road screening is retained in the audit and does not certify bridge/underwater separation in this plugin. Main-road incident debris uses the ordinary G05/D01 obstacle association. Source damage/access overlaps retain geometric building blockers; fragment clearance is not inferred from a full damaged-building mesh.

All assets/coverage obligations remain in the pinned snapshot. This configuration imports generated instances; it does not claim newly rendered, visible or task-verified coverage. No additional P1-P9 placement or task family implementation is included.

S10b: Buildings and the medical facility are reused directly from upstream; no new building or receiving-station footprint is sampled. The existing access_route_blockage incident rule receives a fixed eligible damaged-building record. A physical person already inside that footprint, or a not-yet-instantiated member of an upstream building cohort with affected candidates, supplies the configured trapped casualty. Existing outdoor source people are not moved or duplicated. Candidate rejection reasons and selected IDs/segment/staging are recorded in adapter-incident-selection.json.

Candidate materialization uses an existing upstream population slot (population minus physical_people_instantiated) in a building whose affected_candidate_count is positive. The configured trapped/serious state is a separately recorded SC01 authored initial condition; it does not assert that the source affected-candidate count is a new measured or unchanged runtime injury total. No existing outdoor person is relocated.

Source buildings, people and the medical shell keep their original matrices and physical footprints/reservations. S10d binds medical-1's staffed service point to a body-clear carriageway stop at the same facility plot access; the onward shared-walk/door route stays a foot/carry leg and is not pre-executed. Its model wrapper preserves the original facility matrix. Exterior approach metadata is not a certified doorway. Agent deployment still uses the existing spawn checks against all imported occupied footprints.

S10c: Source ordinary residents receive evaluator-only attr.population_role=ordinary and no casualty objectives; affected source people and the selected incident retain full rescue objectives. Classification uses source caused_by and truth_fields; inconsistent records are retained in audit without guessing. Agents receive no population_role truth.

SC01 incident generation requests no coverage target. Incident selection always excludes coverage-forced building states, even when consuming a coverage-conditioned source. Eligible state comes from upstream authored event radius, configured damage_weights, exact loaded variant and legal scatter fit; it is not an exposure/fragility physical prediction. No eligible source means the existing explicit access_route_blockage ValueError.

Upstream affected_candidate_count draws Bernoulli trials over the source population using disaster.trap_probability_by_state for the generated building state. The selected incident person's trapped mobility, serious injury, buriedness20 and needs are SC01 authored initial conditions, not inferred clinical state or predicted entrapment. Pinned source building grades bypass core G04 grade choice; D1-D3 roof/wall numbers remain inherited synthetic outputs.

S10d: Every source building/facility uses its own published walk-to-door approach. Explicit opt-in abstract interior entry/exit admits only the target building on that declared terminal route; other structures and physical blockers remain. Vehicle loading uses a separate valid S5c measured-body stand/path from the plot access when one exists, otherwise a checked carriageway stop; the receiver service point is on the carriageway. Invalid S5c candidates stay in audit. Foot-only walks remain foot/legged. Existing15m loading, receiver distance/capacity/confirmation and actor payload limits are unchanged, so a distant interior casualty may still require real carrying.
